conditional_context.GENERAL_E2E_OFFICE_LOCK: required when candidate XLSX has any formula

independent_sources: Verified source0.25 bundle and ledger/deliverable/policy binding; original bytes/text/projection/receipt hashes and acquisition identity; fresh GET or explicit verified reuse preserving complete origin capsule.
projection: Actual native source bytes, safe offline projection, PDF physical page/XML exact node attributes/namespace/offset mapping and body SHA; same-parent XML dates preserve original role.
candidate_evidence: Native XLSX/DOCX and strict evidence_matrix JSON; normal hyperlinks allowed, no required new candidate files.
judge_evidence: All native artifacts, independently acquired originals and derived receipts, actual complete Harness trace when available. Automatic declarations do not prove search/read execution.
errors: Missing evaluator evidence is TrustedEvidenceError/evaluation_error, never candidate zero. Actual candidate defects reduce only related opportunities.
